column1: # rulings.tsv: the one file that holds the five DECIDE rulings (plan T14, assumption A2, open item OI-5).
# Status PROVISIONAL means the in-house outcome stands until the owner rules; a ruling is the change of the value cell of one row (with status RULED, ruled_by and ruled_on).
# value is the ruled value; alt_value is the alternative to the in-house value and never changes; expected is the outcome of the vector under the in-house value and expected_alt under alt_value.
# A change to this file changes the semantics fingerprint: bump EngineInfo.SEMANTICS_MAJOR and re-pin SemanticsFingerprintTest in the same commit; a ruled vector changes class to MUST in vectors.tsv.
# L01 NOT_A_VECTOR spec 6.2: no loops; bounded quantifiers would need a spec amendment (owner)

column10: 1 + dec('0.5') == dec('1.5'): may an int be mixed with a decimal in operator form
event.venue == 'XPAR' && has(event.venue) with the venue absent: is the error of the left operand absorbed when the right is false
(1 / 0 == 1) || true: is the error of the left operand absorbed when the right is true
has(client.parent.lei) with client.parent declared and unbound: false or an ABSENT error
no alternative: needs an enum literal (enum with string equality is by name; a TYPE_ERROR ruling is a plan amendment)
